unitTitle: The Turtle, the Elephant and the Hippopotamus
title: Days of the Week Practice
subject: English Language
objectives: Talk about what you do on each day of the week
Use the correct day names in conversation

blocks.text: What do you do every day?

blocks.caption: Each day has its own activities.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Emeka, what do you do every Sunday?

lines.speaker: Emeka
lines.text: I go to church every Sunday.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Ngozi, where do you go every Monday?

lines.speaker: Ngozi
lines.text: I go to school every Monday.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Jibril, what do you learn every Tuesday?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Kunle, what do you do every Wednesday?

lines.speaker: Kunle
lines.text: I wash my uniform every Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Akpan, what do you do every Thursday?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Mohammed, where do you go every Friday?

lines.speaker: Mohammed
lines.text: I go to the mosque every Friday.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Ayo, what do you do every Saturday?

lines.speaker: Ayo
lines.text: I wash my clothes every Saturday.

blocks.md: **Practice:** Say what you do on each day of the week. 'On Monday, I ___.' 'On Sunday, I ___.'

quiz.q: What does Emeka do every Sunday?
quiz.explain: Emeka says 'I go to church every Sunday.'

quiz.q: Where does Ngozi go every Monday?
quiz.explain: Ngozi says 'I go to school every Monday.'

quiz.q: What does Kunle do every Wednesday?
quiz.explain: Kunle says 'I wash my uniform every Wednesday.'

quiz.q: Where does Mohammed go every Friday?
quiz.explain: Mohammed says 'I go to the mosque every Friday.'
